title: High-visibility onboarding assets: icon weight, token mapping, and screenshot staging
creator: Ava Patel
description: Audit and remediate onboarding and quickstart visual assets to meet WCAG contrast targets and improve legibility in low-light/dark themes. Deliverables: updated SVG icon set with stroke/fill variants, color token mappings for light/dark/contrast-high themes, a set of staged product screenshots (desktop + mobile) with accessible overlays and annotations, updated Figma components and a rollout checklist for publishing to docs and console release assets.
acceptance_criteria: All primary onboarding icons render clearly at 16px and 24px with 2px minimum stroke or optimized fills
Color token mapping ensures AA contrast for body copy and AAA where called out (hero headings, CTA text) in dark and light themes
Staged screenshots include 1x and 2x exports for desktop/mobile, with overlays for callouts and an accessible text-only alt sheet
Design tokens published to the tokens repo and engineering has working CSS vars + example page in storybook
Sign-off from PM (product onboarding owner) and Eng (frontend owner) recorded in ticket comments
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Ran audit across current onboarding flows in Console and Docs; identified 18 icon instances failing AA contrast when used on dark surfaces (table in Drive)
2026-03-04: Created first pass of high-contrast icon set in Figma (file: Figma > Redwood Inference / Onboarding Assets / High-Contrast Pack)
2026-03-06: Engineering requested separate stroke and filled variants to enable runtime switching; added note to deliver both SVGs and inline React-friendly components
2026-03-09: PM reviewed and asked that primary CTA text remain AAA in hero states; adjusted color palette and updated token proposal
2026-03-12: Generated staged screenshots for quickstart: desktop 1440px, mobile 375x812, exported 1x and 2x; uploaded to Drive and linked below
2026-03-14: Design review scheduled with frontend on 2026-03-16 to validate Storybook integration and retina asset handling
engineering_notes: Frontend owner @marcus.chen asked for SVGs with role/presentational attributes and focus states documented
Need Storybook example route: /storybook/onboarding-assets/high-contrast showcasing tokens and CSS var toggles
Edge case: some legacy screenshots include small UI elements that cannot reach AAA without layout changes; broke out subtask to add stroke outlines for micro-controls
pm_feedback: PM (Riley Morgan) prefers prioritized rollout for first-time user flow (signup -> quickstart) before secondary help pages
Request to include analytics flag for A/B rollout of high-contrast assets to measure engagement uplift
qa_checklist: Verify icon legibility at 16px and 24px on both light/dark backgrounds
Run contrast report (axe or internal tool) against exported screenshots and live storybook page
Confirm alt-text / accessible descriptions are provided in the alt-sheet for each screenshot
Check retina @2x exports for alignment and consistent padding
Smoke test in Chrome/Firefox/Safari and macOS dark mode + Windows high contrast
notes_and_links: Related PR: https://github.com/redwoodinference/console/pull/EXAMPLE-1234 (pending - storybook route + CSS vars)
final_decisions: Adopt 2px minimum stroke for line icons used at 16px; filled variants will be used when stroke compromises recognition
Introduce color tokens: --color-onboarding-hero, --color-onboarding-cta, --color-onboarding-muted with accessible contrast pairs
Provide both SVG and optimized PNG exports for documentation consumers and legacy integrations
